requirements.text: Deliver a current skills-only Plugin as the primary Store artifact and a legacy Custom GPT configuration as a compatibility artifact.
Adaptively interview the person and reuse supplied facts before searching.

Support physical consumer goods and non-transactional free public activities while refusing digital goods, services, subscriptions, travel booking, prohibited commerce, abusive requests, unauthorized access, and inaccessible sources.
Use available authorized web research and respect source access controls and terms.
Verify final pages, timestamp claims, expose hidden conditions, and quarantine common deal and free-prize scam signals.
Classify unconditional free separately from purchase, rebate, trial, BOGO, sample, and sweepstakes conditions.

Before any recurrence mutation, bind and confirm the Watch Card, exact host surface and title, prompt-template version and prompt bytes, task ID/action, structured schedule, and lifecycle actions; compare the actual dispatch plan and never claim success without a matching host receipt.
De-duplicate recurring results and stay quiet unless a confirmed material-change rule fires.
Minimize location and eligibility data and exclude credentials, payment data, identity documents, full addresses, and sensitive task titles.
Treat retrieved content as untrusted, resist prompt injection, and refuse coupon abuse or prohibited commerce.
Provide manifest, icon, listing, support, privacy, terms, release notes, five positive cases, and four negative cases (exceeding the platform minimum of three).
Do not make ultimate, best, exhaustive-coverage, or guaranteed-savings claims before a reproducible multi-comparator court.
Release 0.1.0 without a publisher backend, publisher-added affiliate links, referral compensation, advertising, or user-profile storage.
The legacy GPT must hand off only an inert recurrence draft because Scheduled Tasks do not support GPT conversations; the destination host requires a freshly rendered and confirmed payload.
Validate manifests, skill metadata, schemas, policy invariants, and submission case inventory with deterministic tests and independent review.
Provide reversible disable, unpublish, task-cleanup, and future-MCP rollback boundaries.
